title: Secrets Management
description: Store and retrieve secrets using dedicated tools instead of config files.

data.text:
**Secrets Management**

API keys, connection strings, and certificates must never live in source code or plain-text config files.

items: Azure Key Vault: managed cloud secrets
Environment variables: simple, but rotation is manual
Rotate: change secrets on a schedule

data.title: Azure Key Vault in .NET

items: Use git-secrets or gitleaks to scan commits
Rotate any secret that was ever committed

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Secrets management turns credential sprawl into a controlled, auditable system.
